testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23091 admin removes the sales rep from a user with the brush icon

scenario.summary: For a user with a sales rep, the admin clicks the brush icon next to Sales Rep and saves; the association is removed and the field is blank.
steps: Accounts & Users > Users; open the user with a sales rep (@assigned.userName) with Manage.
Click the brush icon next to Sales Rep.
Click Save and Close; re-open the user.
stateChanges: The user's sales rep is removed (both deleted at teardown).
assertions: The sales rep association is removed: the Sales Rep field is blank on Manage User
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 9 (group B remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 9.3.
Precondition: USER_ASSIGNED_TO_SALES_REP with rep = @rep.userId, checked on the Sales Rep field before the first step.
atstage 10.14.7.0: the brush icon is 'Clear Sales Rep Name' (btnClearSalesRepName).
Manage User requires first and last name and the created user has none: the test fills names it makes up (created-by-test) before Save and Close, as 23085.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A). Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId (any other active webstore).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
